notes: Summary: Cobalt Ridge builds real-time trading advisory agents for retail brokers. Extremely latency-sensitive; even small tail reductions improve fill rates.

Primary ask: consistent sub-60ms p95 on conversational scoring + reranking pipeline at 30-60 QPS. Heavy cost pressure — goal to cut per-request GPU time via batching, KV caching and aggressive quantization.
Model preference: open to Llama-2/Meta 13B family and Mistral variants; wants 4-bit or int8 quant profiles. CTO quote: 'If we can't drop cost by ~3x vs current hosts, we won't proceed.'
Batching/caching interest: want intelligent batching that respects latency SLOs; prefix-KV caching for repeated context across sessions; evaluate cache hit thresholds and eviction policies.

Perf benchmarking ask (explicit): end-to-end single-turn latency with streaming enabled, p95/p99, throughput at target batch sizes (1,2,4,8), and cold vs warm KV cache comparisons. Provide per-token cost estimate and percentile breakdowns.
Security/compliance: must run in VPC for prod; proof of KMS integration and audit log retention; data residency in us-east required for first rollout.
POC success criteria: meet p95 latency target at 50 QPS with cost below threshold on Dedicated; deterministic fallback to smaller model under load; documented regression tests.
Stated blockers: internal procurement timeline, legal redlines on retention, and realistic benchmark variance (their baseline uses highly-optimized custom kernels).
Communication style: short, action-oriented. Use-case owner (CTO Aaron Li) prefers numbers and repeatable harness scripts.
